About this page

This page was first published in May 2017 as a redesigned successor of the original At A Glance: UK General Election 2015 pages published in May 2015. Information on this page may change as a result of any inaccuracies identified. Key sources of data for this page include Parliament.uk, the Electoral Commission, Wikipedia and the BBC.

This page uses a modified version of MixItUp from Kunka Labs.

Selected photographs of MPs have been sourced (then modified and re-formatted) from the UK Parliament website under an Attribution 3.0 Unported (CC BY 3.0) license
